Strategy
Nordea Savings 50 is a balanced fund that invests its assets mainly in other Nordea Funds. The basic weighting of the fund's assets is: 50% in equity funds and 50% in fixed-income funds. Depending on the market situation, the weight of equity fund investments varies from 40% to 60%.
